summary: Jackson Financial Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a new $1.25 billion unsecured revolving credit agreement, replacing a prior $1 billion facility. The credit agreement provides for working capital and general corporate purposes, including a $500 million letter-of-credit sub-limit, with an option to increase commitments by $500 million. Interest is based on SOFR or base rate plus a ratings-dependent margin. The facility matures June 30, 2031, with two one-year extension options. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
